records.title: CoNP-completeness of binary directed chip-firing reachability
records.description:
Ordinary legal chip-firing reachability is coNP-complete under deterministic polynomial-time many-one reductions for finite loopless strongly connected directed multigraphs, with binary adjacency entries, nonnegative binary initial and target configurations, and varying vertex count. An explicit NONHALTING-to-REACHABLE map uses a finite-state cutoff, exact pre-gate simulation, a gate cleanup budget, and a marker that forces the first gate in every target-reaching word. The complete proof includes loop relays, signed-source threshold normalization, singleton and malformed-input cases, arbitrary target-reaching firing counts, binary output bounds, and the credited reduced-count coNP certificate. It answers the historical general-digraph hardness question in this precise model; no simple-graph, unary, bounded-degree, bounded-chip-count or signed-membership extension is asserted.

Farrell-Levine supplies source hardness and the total-Laplacian interface; Björner-Lovász supplies period deletion and reduced counts; Hujter-Kiss-Tóthmérész supplies coNP membership and the recurrent-target theorem; Tóthmérész supplies the earlier recurrence-to-reachability conversion and hierarchy barrier; Kiss-Tóthmérész 2015, Section 4, supplies prior large-reserve finite-horizon simulation. Neither scaling nor reserve simulation in general is claimed as new. Exact-result, gadget and method priority, independent discovery and present-day worldwide openness remain UNKNOWN after the bounded audit. Unavailable and uninspected original sources remain UNKNOWN.

The upload includes the paper and a portable standard-library verification kit with complete proof source, new exact finite controls and deliberate faults, scoped source metadata, individual custody decisions and deterministic integrity tools. These supplement the written proof; they do not replay the original edition's omitted historical programs or certify a universal theorem by finite tests. AI tools were used extensively in solving, checking, programming, source comparison and writing. This work is unrefereed; internal AI reviews are not external human peer review, journal acceptance or proof-assistant certification.

records.title: A modular-storage proof of NP-completeness for chip-firing halting on simple digraphs
records.description:
A complete attributed proof that ordinary conservative chip-firing HALTING is NP-complete under deterministic polynomial-time many-one reductions on finite loopless simple strongly connected digraphs with nonnegative binary configurations. Hardness holds with polynomial numerical total initial chips and a specified root whose deletion leaves an acyclic graph with no path of two arcs. The main construction permits antiparallel arcs; a separately proved oriented construction forbids them. The proof includes actual legal checkpoints, conservation, schedule-independent least action, polynomial output bounds, all preprocessing cases and a polynomial-bit NP certificate.

The literal modular-bank formula and parallel primed-toppler mechanism are credited to Holroyd, Levine and Winkler, Abelian logic gates, arXiv:1511.00422v2, Lemma 4.1. The prime Boolean and local clause-product encoding is credited to Stockmeyer and Meyer, STOC 1973, Theorem 6.1, and its reconstruction by Gregor Gramlich alone, MFCS 2003, Fact 3. The allowed-predicate intersection is the complement of the classical invalid-variable or failed-clause union; extra local nonBoolean clause-complement residues are already variable-invalid. Neither ingredient nor avoiding global-period expansion is claimed as new. NP membership, capacity and the root-last viewpoint are prior Farrell-Levine/Farrell methods, and long simple-graph clocks are prior Eriksson. Full-result, conservative simple/oriented realization and remaining method priority, and preexisting worldwide openness, remain UNKNOWN after a bounded audit.

AI tools were used extensively in solving, verification, source comparison, programming and writing. This is an unrefereed preprint, without external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. No firstness is claimed. The support ZIP contains the complete TeX source, exact authored historical snapshots, bibliographic hashes/read scopes and fresh standard-library finite diagnostics with meaningful faults. No third-party source bodies are redistributed, no omitted historical program is claimed replayed, and finite tests do not certify the unbounded proof or the literature.
